row.title: DISCLOSURE-RETIRED-1: the disclosure gate (PF-1) is retired
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-21: no patent and no IP filing; the work is source-available under the Ultrastable License, non-commercial use free, commercial use needs a paid license. The disclosure rule, the dashboard disclosure_guard probe (which failed hourly) and its word list are removed; nothing is held back from public view.
